d:
The Wizards defeated the Raptors, 103-99 tonight in Toronto. Anthony Davis contributed a team-high 25 points to go with 14 rebounds 2 assists and 2 three pointers, with AJ Dybantsa of the Wizards adding an additional 23 points (9-17 FG) in the game. Immanuel Quickley finished with a team-high 24 points along with 5 assists for the Raptors in the losing effort. The Wizards improve their record to 5-11 with the win, while the Raptors fall to 5-10 for the season.
